cache_accounting.note: On a cache hit the SCG build cost was paid by an earlier cell; the hit cell is attributed the cache load time instead of a fabricated 0 s build. Cache-hit cells are flagged in normalized_tasks.csv (scg_cache_status, cache_hit).

caveats: Every time quantile is computed over COMPLETED cells only; TIMEOUT cells are right-censored at the cell cap and never imputed as completions.
INC means completed-but-inconclusive (e.g. SCG state limit) and is reported as its own denominator; it is not zero work and not a VER/AMB.
Cell compute time depends on the runner environment and the optimized implementation; only within-run paired contrasts are meaningful.

The Pilot C sweep mixes mode=first at low/mid L with mode=complete at high L; synchronizer state and candidate-word counts are mode-independent, verdict changes are not. The formal C1/C2 sweeps fix the mode per sweep, so the clean L contrast uses the same-mode levels only.
Candidate-word and state counts are null (not zero) when the stage never executed; the observed-n columns give the denominator for each median.

cost_accounting.note: Runner-time accounting for budget planning only. It is not an independent model-performance metric; do not sum across environments or protocol versions.

l_sensitivity.definition: A sweep is L-sensitive when the depth-L synchronizer actually depends on L: synchronizer states grow with L, candidate words appear only at larger L, or the verdict changes with L. sync_states/candidate_words are mode-independent; verdict changes are not when a sweep mixes modes, so the confounded count is reported explicitly.
